preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The grid has between 1 and 1000 rows and columns.
The values in the grid cells are between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= y_{i} <= H and 1 <= x_{i} <= W for each valid i
preconditions.description: Each particle is located in a valid cell within the grid.
The absolute values of the particle values are between 0 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: no two particles are located in the same cell
preconditions.description: Each cell contains at most one particle.

preconditions.expression: The sum of H \cdot W over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all grids does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output contains a single integer representing the maximum value of V.
postconditions.description: The maximum value of V is calculated and output.

postconditions.expression: The second line of the output contains N space-separated integers representing the signs of the particle values.
postconditions.description: The signs of the particle values are output such that the value of V is maximized.
